item.text:
Performed another refactor in the UI layer.

`SimulatorView` now uses a type-safe color registry with `Map<Class<?>, Color>` and a narrower `setColor(Class<? extends Actor>, Color)` signature in [SimulatorView.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R009_module_java/SimulatorView.java:35) and [SimulatorView.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R009_module_java/SimulatorView.java:109). That removes one of the remaining raw-type seams in the codebase.

I also split `showStatus(...)` in [SimulatorView.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R009_module_java/SimulatorView.java:171) into smaller helpers: actor rendering and infection counting now live in [showActor(...) ](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R009_module_java/SimulatorView.java:206), the day/time label update is in [updateDayLabel() ](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R009_module_java/SimulatorView.java:221), and the remaining info/popuulation label updates are in [updateInfoLabels(...) ](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/R009_module_java/SimulatorView.java:233). The rendering flow and infection counting behavior are unchanged.

Verification: `javac *.java` succeeds.
